constructionRules.units: normalized fictional body units; not physical performance

supportEquations.air: bilateral membrane roots && spanArea * coordination * actuatorCapacity >= load * 2
supportEquations.water: axialCount >= 3 && axialActuator && fins && amplitude <= bodyWidth / 2 && actuatorCapacity >= load
supportEquations.cost: load * cycleRate * efficiency; normalized matched-action index, not metabolism

constructionRules.geometry: Connected repeated ellipsoid volumes; bilateral 2 or radial 3 placements. Root u = 0.4 * placement + 0.6 * (group+1)/(groupCount+1). Rooted chains/membranes/fins stay distinct even on a single volume. Joint requests beyond their declared range reject. No mesh collision or fluid solver.
constructionRules.expressionVariation: Marking placement in local surface coordinates only; inherited enable/layout/extent stay fixed.

reproductionContract.mechanism: One actual recorded copy from each parent per executable locus; no desired-child retries.
